Group rides in Pennsylvania

30 recurring group rides around Pennsylvania: 23 road, 13 social, 3 gravel. 22 roll on weeknights, 5 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Slow Roll Erie in Erie — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Thursday Evening Special (Lancaster Bicycle Club) runs a: 20 to 22 mph. A+: 22 to 24 mph. Race-like, pacelining; e-bikes not recommended.
